inactive_lanes.C_shim_choice: Zero totalization in rd_splat/rd_read_lane/rd_out_lane/rd_active_wadd16/rd_active_wadd32 outside active lanes
inactive_lanes.ISA_status: Not a claim that RVV tail-agnostic means zero. RVVv1.0 section3.4.3 distinguishes retaining old values and all-ones; C-shim zero is a model totalization outside the observed active prefix, not a proved complete-register ISA correspondence.
